question: Should OpenClaw restore `PluginRuntime.channel.turn.*` as a deprecated runtime compatibility alias for shipped third-party channel plugins?
rationale: The implementation is narrow, but repository policy treats public plugin SDK/runtime compatibility as upgrade-sensitive; preserving a retired API name in core runtime is a maintainer product/contract decision.

options.title: Restore Deprecated Alias
options.body: Land this alias after resolving conflicts, with `channel.turn` object-identical to `channel.inbound` and docs continuing to steer new code to inbound.

options.title: Reject Alias
options.body: Keep the runtime strict and require affected third-party plugins to republish against `channel.inbound.*`, accepting the upgrade break for old builds.

recommendation.title: Restore Deprecated Alias
recommendation.body: Land this alias after resolving conflicts, with `channel.turn` object-identical to `channel.inbound` and docs continuing to steer new code to inbound.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete authored the alias-removal commit and the broader inbound refactor history, so they are the clearest available owner for the compatibility direction.
